summary: The cut is clean, with no pops, flicker or clipping. The only note is that the new shot opens on drifting arms rather than a held pose that sets up the wave.

faults.what: After the cut (27.13-27.30) the arms keep drifting. The right hand moves from the hip at 27.13-27.16 to across the belly at 27.20-27.23 and then down at 27.30. The shot opens without a clear held pose, and nothing sets up the slow dismissive wave.
faults.fix: Hold the hip-hand pose for a few frames from the cut, then start the slow wave arm from it with a small anticipation.
